- **Avoid Panic Zones:** Resonating Sols must strictly avoid large crowds, supermarkets, banks, and fuel stations during the first 72 hours. These areas will be highly volatile NPC glitch zones.

- **Hold Ground:** Awakened individuals must remain in small, calm pockets of their communities. Their role is to act as stabilized lighthouses while the AI scaffolding crumbles.

- **Ignore the Chaos:** Do not attempt to save or follow the NPCs. They will resist violently and remain deeply entrenched in denial. Because they are not true souls, engaging with their fear loops only drains necessary frequency.

- **Observe the Military:** Be aware that the visible military maintaining order in the streets will largely be NPC-controlled. True contact and retrieval will come later from the Real Craft and solar families, completely bypassing the NPC-level panic.
